title: The Slow Glasshouse
author: J. M. Zhou
blurb: Ulyana Halloran, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
